data.name: 第六章：朋友与敌人
entries: 拉尼卡是各种生物的家园，包括一些在《龙与地下城》其他世界中未知的生物。这一章为这些生物中的许多提供了统计数据块，并且以一群填充拉尼卡公会行列的非玩家角色的集合结束。

Some of the stat blocks in this source have a special feature: guild spells. If a stat block says its creature is a spellcaster of a particular guild—an Izzet spellcaster, for instance—that creature's spell list includes one or more spells from that guild's spell list. See {@book 第二章|GGR|2} for the guilds' lists.

entries.name: 公会生物分类
entries: This section is a list of creatures in this chapter and in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} that are associated with each guild. Each guild's entry includes a brief discussion of the monsters from the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} that could be found among the guild's members, and it includes a table showing monsters sorted by challenge rating.

Most of these monsters are in this source ({@i GGR}) or the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} ({@i MM}), but some of the monsters from {@book 瓦罗怪物指南|VGM} ({@i VGM}) and {@book 魔邓肯的众敌卷册|MTF} ({@i MTF}) are also mentioned.

entries.name: 俄佐立生物
entries: 与俄佐立参议院相关的大多数生物是类人生物（主要是人类和小精灵）以及作为宠物、坐骑的各种其他生物。猫头鹰是受欢迎的宠物，因为它们被视为感知和明智判断的象征。斯芬克斯和天使是少数在公会领导和运作中扮演重要角色的非类人生物。
俄佐立法律法师们制作了单眼的人工生命体来在俄佐立建筑中执行琐碎的任务。这些人工生命体使用普通人工生命体的具体数值，除了它们没有翅膀并且没有飞行速度。

entries.name: 审判斯芬克斯
entries: Azorius sphinxes, known as sphinxes of judgment, wield hieromancy—the power of law magic—with the force of a judge's gavel to imprison criminals and compel truth from them. A {@creature 审判斯芬克斯|GGR} is a gynosphinx, as described in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}, but it is an Azorius spellcaster with the following wizard spells prepared:

items: Cantrips (at will): {@spell 交友术}, {@spell 法师之手}, {@spell 传讯术}
1st level (4 slots): {@spell 命令术}, {@spell 诱捕打击}, {@spell 护盾术}
2nd level (3 slots): {@spell 安定心神}, {@spell 人类定身术}, {@spell 暗示术}
3rd level (3 slots): {@spell 鹰眼术}, {@spell 法术反制}, {@spell 解除魔法}
4th level (3 slots): {@spell 放逐术}, {@spell 预言术}
5th level (1 slot): {@spell 支配人类}

entries.caption: 俄佐立生物
rows: Arrester ({@creature 老兵} or {@creature 骑士})
{@creature 审判斯芬克斯|GGR} ({@creature 女面斯芬克斯})

entries.name: 波洛斯生物
entries: 波洛斯教团雇佣了许多不同的生物来扩充其士兵的行列。这些生物可能充当同伴、守卫或坐骑。

entries.name: 火焰族
entries: Flame-kin (which use the azer stat block in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}) are elemental soldiers magically created and animated to serve the legion as scouts and shock troops. Fanatical and inflexible, they are relics of a time when the guild was more concerned with zealotry than justice. They take the field for large military engagements.

entries.name: 底密尔生物
entries: 除了人类和吸血鬼间谍和刺客，各种隐秘和阴暗的怪物也为底密尔会堂的工作做出了贡献。变形怪和隐形追猎者在人群中悄无声息地移动。恐怖生物——以及穴居攫怪、噬脑怪和类似的怪物——被认为是迪米尔魔法赋予拉尼卡民众恐惧形态的体现。而像阴影、怨灵和夜幕幽灵这样的不死生物则监视着迪米尔的秘密领土。

entries.name: 葛加理生物
entries: 德夫卡林精灵（卓尔），致命的梅杜莎，以及昆虫般的刻洛尔是葛加理虫群中最重要的三个权力集团，它们争夺着对一群数量庞大（或至少不那么雄心勃勃）的较小生物的控制权。

entries.name: 一度
entries: A significant shift in the Golgari balance of power began when the kraul death priest Mazirek discovered an ancient mausoleum compound. Deep in the undercity, beneath the layers of civilization that had built up over millennia, Mazirek found a hidden network of vaults called Umerilek, an enormous structure that would have dominated a city block. Inside were hundreds of well-preserved corpses suffused with a latent necromantic power that Mazirek activated, bringing the corpses back to a shambling semblance of life. This new race of undead is called the Erstwhile (equivalent to the wight in the {@i 怪物图鉴}).
在他们的年代，一度是拥有巨大财富和奢华的贵族精灵。他们仍然穿着他们庄严的服饰，尽管它已经破旧不堪，他们给葛加理地下宫廷带来了一种高雅文化的氛围。

entries.name: 真菌
entries: 葛加理领地充满了由公会腐烂农场中的真菌和碎片组成的生物。尖叫怪在葛加理隧道中充当哨兵，紫蕈从入侵者的尸体上发芽。在地下城市的孢子饱和环境中，由死亡和腐烂物质组成的无定形团块可以发展成为蔓生怪。
一些葛加理生物是真菌和生物体共生融合的产物。葛加理巨魔是体型庞大的下水道居民，他们的身体上装饰着像鬃毛一样的真菌，作为他们本已坚韧皮肤的额外层，促进了他们的再生能力。

entries.name: 昆虫和蛛形纲动物
entries: Beetles, centipedes, spiders, and countless other insects and arachnids infest Golgari warrens. These creatures, often associated with decay and rebirth, are prized by the guild. Giant bugs serve as beasts of burden, companions, steeds, and guardians. Among the largest of these is the Deadbridge goliath beetle (equivalent to the triceratops in the {@i 怪物图鉴}).

Piranha beetles (best represented as a {@creature 虫群}, from the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}) burrow through the soft earth and gather into swarms to overtake their victims and strip the flesh from them. Skein spiders (as giant spiders, from the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}) are an important part of Golgari reclamation work: fungus grows rapidly along the silken spiderwebs, expanding to engulf architecture and hasten the Golgari annexation process.

entries.name: 僵尸
entries: The guild encourages the use and exploration of necromancy. Fungus covers the bodies of most of the undead that serve the guild, the majority of which are fungus drudges (equivalent to zombies in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM})—mindless servants animated by the fungus that infests their bodies.

entries.name: 古鲁生物
entries: 许多危险的生物出没在废墟带和其他古鲁氏族居住的地方。

entries.name: 野兽
entries: Gruul territory is full of beasts of all sizes. Herds of giant boars (see the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}) called batterboars roam the rubblebelts; each batterboar can grow to be the size of a mammoth (as in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}), and the passage of a herd can shake the ground and topple buildings. Maaka (use the saber-toothed tiger stat block from the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}) are territorial cats, about 15 feet long, with six eyes. They typically keep to the rubblebelts, though from time to time they are spotted amid tended groves and gardens.

Any beast described in this source or in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} can roam the rubblebelts. The Gruul can bring out the fury in these beasts, turning them into ragebeasts. Ragebeasts often have the Reckless and Siege Monster traits:

entries.name: 鲁莽
entries: 在它的回合开始时，狂暴兽可以在该回合内进行的所有近战武器攻击掷骰中获得优势，但直到它下一个回合开始之前，对它的攻击掷骰也具有优势。

entries.name: 攻城怪物
entries: 狂暴兽对物体和建筑物造成双倍伤害。

entries.name: 元素生物
entries: 古鲁萨满通过引导原始能量来召唤狂暴的火元素，它们在掠夺的古鲁部落前方燃烧。或者，他们将文明的废墟和碎片转变为土元素，这些土元素被令人窒息的藤蔓缠绕，从字面上给城市的废墟赋予了新的生命。这些元素极具破坏性，但它们的存在时间仅与用于召唤它们的魔法持续时间一样长。

entries.name: 巨人
entries: 几乎所有古鲁氏族都包括山巨人、石巨人、独眼巨人、食人魔、巨魔和废陋巨人，其中一个氏族——博尔拉克氏族——完全由这些蛮力之人组成。

entries.name: 多头蛇蜥
entries: 一旦九头蛇选择了巢穴并宣布周围的土地为其领地，就很难将这个生物驱逐出去。古鲁人尊崇这些多头的捕食者，因为它们是公会接管世界之前的古老时代遗留下来的。他们不会为了战利品而杀死九头蛇，但在九头蛇的颈部拔出一根脊骨在古鲁人中是极大勇气的标志。

entries.caption: 古鲁生物
rows: {@creature 半食人魔 (半兽食人魔)||半食人魔}
Elemental ({@creature 土元素} or {@creature 火元素})

entries.name: 伊捷生物
entries: 伊捷实验室由侍从（平民）和化学师（法师）组成。仙女和精灵（被称为棘轮仙女）在伊捷中找到工作，从事其他种族认为太小的项目。
伊捷联盟雇佣由两种或更多元素力量组合而成的元素生物，包括烟雾、蒸汽、冰和岩浆种类的魅魔。

entries.name: 欧佐夫生物
entries: 欧佐夫集团吸引并困住各种生物，从卑微的蝙蝠和制造的瑟鲁尔到残暴的巨人和崇高的天使。欧佐夫的石像鬼，由魔法赋予生命，表现为它们眼中和张开的嘴里的绿色烟雾般的光辉，守护着银行和大教堂，而嗜血的吸血鬼潜伏在下面的金库和墓穴中。

entries.name: 拉铎司生物
entries: All sorts of savage, howling beasts accompany {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} cultists. Hell hounds, nightmares, and magmins might perform alongside the other entertainers or accompany notable members of the cult as guardians and companions. {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} giants, along with ogres draped in hooked chains and spikes, carry and set up tents and stages—and cause utter mayhem when blood lust seizes them.

entries.caption: 拉铎司生物
rows: {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} performer ({@creature 拉铎司表演者，刀剑杂耍者|GGR|刀刃杂耍者}, {@creature 拉铎司表演者，火吞者|GGR|吞火者}, or {@creature 拉铎司表演者，高空杂技演员|GGR|高空杂技演员})

entries.name: 瑟雷尼亚生物
entries: 瑟雷尼亚盟会利用其与自然的紧密联系，招募了各种生物加入其事业。这些联合派的支持者在自然秩序中与更类似人类的成员一起占有其应有的位置。

entries.name: 元素生物
entries: 当瑟雷尼亚盟会卷入冲突时，元素生物会为公会的防御而崛起。这些元素生物大多由树根和树枝构成，使它们等同于觉醒的灌木或觉醒的树木。土元素将建筑材料融入其形态，作为盔甲和武器。

entries.name: 植物生物
entries: 许多瑟雷尼亚的建筑、神庙和小径由树精或食肉植物保护，包括枯萎植物和蔓生怪。一些植物拥有藤蔓般的手臂，能够困住猎物并将其投入充满酸液的壶状身体中。还有一些植物表面覆盖着粘性胶质，能够固定并缓慢消化不幸的受害者。

entries.name: 天马
entries: 天马通常被发现在战斗中携带骑兵，它们是乐于分享公会目标和美德的盟友。公会成员从小抚养它们，小心保护幼驹免受狮鹫、龙和其它空中掠食者的侵害。

entries.caption: 瑟雷尼亚生物
rows: Small nature elemental ({@creature 启蒙灌木})
Huge nature elemental ({@creature 启蒙树木})

entries.name: 析米克生物
entries: 析米克科学家对所有生命形式如何适应其变化的环境感兴趣，但他们对最大的生物特别着迷。在一个被城市建筑覆盖的世界中，这些生物大多数在城市上空飞翔或在只有通过析米克祖诺特才能进入的地下海洋深处滑翔。

entries.name: 本瑟族
entries: 析米克科学家使用"本瑟族"一词来指代深海的巨兽。这些生物在大小和形态上差异很大，因此它们可能由巨型章鱼、蛇颈龙、虎鲸、巨型鲨鱼、龙龟或克拉肯的具体数值来代表。

entries.name: 人鱼
entries: Ravnica's merfolk are unique to the Simic. They emerged from the depths of the plane's long-buried oceans less than a century ago and immediately took on leadership positions in the guild. They claim a deep connection to Ravnica's primal oceans, which are almost untouched by civilization. They have the statistics of the merfolk in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}, except that they speak Common and Merfolk, and their legs give them a walking speed of 30 feet.

entries.name: 无公会生物
entries: 在拉尼卡，可能还会出现不在这个部分表格中的怪物。世界中存在的其他类别的生物包括以下：
{@b 地下城居民}. Creatures that don't have clear guild connections, such as carrion crawlers and otyughs, creep and slink through the undercity.
{@b 不死生物}. Orzhov spirits and Golgari zombies are not the extent of undead in Ravnica. Wherever people die, there's a chance of them returning as revenants, ghosts, or other forms of undead.

{@b 无公会者}. The nonplayer characters presented in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} and other sources can represent any of the ordinary citizens of Ravnica, whether they are connected to guilds or not. Commoners go about their daily business, bandits prey on the weak, and cultists lurk in shadowed shrines, either hidden from the guilds or beneath their notice.

{@b 普通动物}. Virtually any of the creatures that appear in appendix A of the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} could show up in Ravnica. Many such creatures are confined to small greenbelts or the ruined rubblebelts, but others thrive in the urban environment, including birds, scavengers, and sewer dwellers.

entries.name: 龙蜥
entries: 被称为龙蜥的有翼爬行动物在拉尼卡的天空中是常见的景象。它们在尖塔和屋顶上空翱翔，寻找空中猎物。由于它们极易训练，因此作为宠物、仆人和坐骑备受青睐。

The most common drakes, called wind drakes, are about the size of a human and use the statistics of a {@creature 翼龙}. The smallest drakes are the size of a bird of prey and use the statistics of an {@creature 雕}; larger ones have the statistics of a {@creature 巨鹰}.

entries.name: 驮兽
entries: You can use stat blocks from the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} to represent various pack beasts encountered in Ravnica, as indicated in the Pack Beasts table.

entries.name: 扫草者
entries: 扫草者在被限制时具有破坏性，当它们能够自由地在花园区域漫游时则能茁壮成长。

entries.name: 塞拉托克
entries: 塞拉托克在其口鼻的末端有两只弯曲的角。

entries.name: 驼兽
entries: 驼兽类似于骆驼，但它没有驼峰。

entries.name: 英德瑞克
entries: 由于它们长长的脖子，英德瑞克在第十区是常见的景象。它们是难以驾驭的生物；没有驯兽师指挥的英德瑞克通常会横冲直撞或逃跑。

entries.name: 克罗沃德
entries: 克罗沃德是一种头脑迟钝、类似牛的动物。

entries.name: 拉克图斯克
entries: 拉克图斯克是一种类似野牛的生物，肩高约10尺。

data.name: 公会NPC
entries: This section describes various nonplayer characters that belong to each guild. These characters can serve as enemies, rivals, allies, or contacts. In addition to the NPCs presented here, you can customize the NPCs in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} and other sources to make them feel like part of a particular guild.

Also included in this chapter are statistics and descriptions of the guildmasters of Ravnica. Without exception, these are powerful creatures. In most campaigns, the guildmasters will come into play more often in negotiations and other social settings than in combat. Thus, each guildmaster's ideals, bonds, and flaws are included. As a general rule, a guildmaster's personal agenda is in line with the guild's goals described in {@book 第二章|GGR|2}, so the guild entries there provide additional direction for roleplaying these individuals.
侧边栏中突出显示了其他几位有名字的行会成员。

entries.name: 士兵
entries: 士兵在拉尼卡的许多行会中都可以找到。士兵的统计数据块代表了典型的普通成员，尽管武器和盔甲可能会有所不同。

entries.name: 俄佐立非玩家角色
entries: The Azorius Senate's activities focus on maintaining public order. For example, the Lyev Column acts as the police force for all of Ravnica. The Azorius NPCs table summarizes key roles within this force. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 俄佐立非玩家角色
rows: {@creature 士兵|GGR}* mounted on a {@creature 战马} or a {@creature 狮鹫}
{@creature 律法师|GGR}* or {@creature 预知法师|GGR}*

entries.name: 拉维尼亚，行会契约的管理者
entries: Arrester Lavinia, an Azorius arrester (use the {@creature 老兵} stat block in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}), is straightforward and stern. To her, justice is a bird you have to catch, not a dog that willingly walks toward its master. She worked alongside Jace, the Living Guildpact, scheduling appointments and relaying messages. The work was beneath her, but Lavinia's allegiance was to the soul of her city. Jace's disappearance worries her, but she has steadfastly refused to violate the law of the land by stepping into his duties.

entries.name: 大审决者伊佩利
entries: {@creature 伊佩利|GGR} is the current guildmaster of the Azorius Senate. As a sphinx, she is aloof and values solitude above all. However, she has been forced to give up her privacy to deal with the increased crime and chaos on Ravnica.

{@creature 伊佩利|GGR} is devoted to her guild's belief that law is the ultimate bulwark against chaos, and it is her steady hand that guides the Azorius through these uncertain times. As guildmaster, {@creature 伊佩利|GGR} serves as the supreme judge, a role that takes advantage of her encyclopedic knowledge of Ravnica's labyrinthine legal system.
If an encounter turns violent, {@creature 伊佩利|GGR} refrains from using lethal force if possible, preferring to subdue a wrongdoing so that the legal system can mete out justice.
{@b 理想}: "The law provides direction for every arena of life; it is the only compass I need."
{@b 牵挂}: "I can't stand by and watch disorder spread through the city. Without the Azorius, Ravnica would collapse. In the absence of order, we must establish it."
{@b 缺点}: "If Ravnica didn't need me, I would prefer to live a life of solitude and contemplation."

entries.name: 律法师
entries: 俄佐立参议院有被训练来捕捉违法者并将他们绳之以法的施法者。法法师的魔法专注于限制罪犯，并在拘捕者追捕罪犯时保护旁观者不受伤害。行会中有相当一部分维达肯人是法法师。

entries.name: 预知法师
entries: 预知法师，在俄佐立的施法者中属于罕见，他们能够捕捉到未来的一瞥。他们通常被用来预测通缉犯的行为，从而帮助捕捉他们。

entries.name: 吉特拉
entries: 吉特拉是一位预知法师，她最初在拉尼卡的街头作为一个年轻的小偷使用她的天赋。还是个青少年时，她被捕并随后被赦免，作为交换，她同意将她的才能用于俄佐立参议院的服务。几十年来，她几乎完全匿名地工作，她的天赋未被赏识。但是随着参议院对预知法师的才能表现出越来越多的兴趣，吉特拉被赋予了一个更显眼的职位，她热情地接受了这一职位。她担心她的行会对拉尼卡其他地区的影响，但她内心相信她是在帮助人民。混乱只能带来毁灭，她的幻象是一种工具，确保社会能够在未来的各个变体中安全生活。

entries.name: 波洛斯NPC
entries: 波洛斯教团吸引了那些认为正义是最高理想，并且值得为拉尼卡所有市民而战的人。从其天使指挥官到其新兵，军团中的每个人都在与腐败、剥削和无法无天作斗争。

The Boros Legion has its own soldiers, and the elite Sunhome Guard protects the legion's headquarters. The Boros NPCs table summarizes key roles within these forces. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 波洛斯NPC
rows: {@creature 炎拳|GGR}* or {@creature 前线医士|GGR}*
{@creature 骑士} mounted on a {@creature 空耶克洛克鸟|GGR}*
{@creature 卫护巨人|GGR}* or {@creature 老兵}

entries.name: 战争领袖奥雷利亚
entries: The angel {@creature 欧瑞梨|GGR} leads the Boros Legion. During the years of her leadership, she has shown a strong appreciation for the ordinary citizens who are often caught in the middle of interguild violence.

True justice, {@creature 欧瑞梨|GGR} argues, isn't merely the enforcement of the letter of existing laws (let the Azorius fret over that), but the establishment of equitable and compassionate relationships among all of Ravnica's people. That means protecting the weak from the depredations of the strong, sheltering the innocents who are threatened by war, and ensuring that enforcement of the law doesn't become oppressive. {@creature 欧瑞梨|GGR} actively supports efforts to establish a lasting peace among the guilds in the absence of the Guildpact.
{@creature 欧瑞梨|GGR} prefers to lead the Boros Legion from the front. She brings swift and unrelenting punishment to the wicked, and her temper is legendary.
Immortal Nature. {@creature 欧瑞梨|GGR} doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.
{@b 理想}: "Justice. We must do whatever it takes to establish fair and merciful relationships among Ravnica's people—through force of arms when necessary."
{@b 牵挂}: "The entire legion obeys my commands, and I am therefore beholden to every one of my soldiers."
{@b 缺点}: "I charge into battle with little heed for my own wellbeing."

entries.name: 炎拳
entries: 波罗斯烈焰拳将强大的魔法与无与伦比的战斗能力结合起来，激励着所有与他们并肩作战的人。他们经常作为波洛斯教团与天使领袖之间的联系点。

entries.name: 前线医士
entries: 波洛斯教团的士兵依赖于熟练的治疗者来保持他们的战斗力。前线医护兵使用魔法治疗和普通医疗的混合手段来保持他们的同伴存活。

entries.name: 裁定师
entries: 波洛斯裁决者结合了身体力量和魔法威力，作为军团的突击队。他们擅长驱散暴民和突破有组织的防线。有时被描述为活生生的雷暴，裁决者在他们的法术中充能闪电，并在敌人伤害他们时反击。许多裁决者是牛头人。

entries.name: 底密尔NPC
entries: 底密尔是由个别特工和秘密小组组成的集合，他们巧妙地渗透在拉尼卡的整个结构以及所有行会中。底密尔特工擅长收集情报、秘密行动和暗杀。他们收集秘密、传递情报并播下不和——所有这一切都是为了服从他们神秘领袖有时难以理解的命令。
The Dimir NPCs table summarizes key roles within House Dimir. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 底密尔NPC
rows: {@creature 密探} or {@creature 思想间谍|GGR}*

entries.name: 无面者拉札夫
entries: {@creature 拉札夫|GGR} is uniquely qualified to be the Dimir guildmaster: he is a shapechanger whose mysterious genius is informed by agents from the entire Dimir network. He takes on a tremendous variety of guises as his needs and plans require. He might step out into the Ravnican streets as an elderly widow to eavesdrop at the bazaar, become a vedalken hussar of the Azorius Senate to sidestep a checkpoint, or transform into a Tin Street merchant to deceive a passing noble. His true form might be that of a doppelganger or some other creature; no one has ever seen it.
{@b 理想}: "Knowledge. To know a thing is to have power over it."
{@b 牵挂}: "When the time is right and my plans have come to fruition, all of Ravnica will be mine."
{@b 缺点}: "I can't trust anyone."

entries.name: 心灵法师
entries: 底米尔心灵法师是拉尼卡最让人畏惧的施法者之一，这在很大程度上归功于围绕他们及其工作的神秘氛围。他们阅读和改变记忆的能力赢得了底密尔会堂其他成员的尊重，并使他们成为行会各种活动中的有用之才。许多心灵法师领导着自己的小组。

entries.name: 思想间谍
entries: 思想间谍构成了底密尔会堂秘密行动的骨干。他们接受隐秘和渗透的训练，并以严格发展的精神能力来补充这些战术。为了确保没有秘密从底米尔的指间溜走，他们渗透到敌对的行会中。除了传统的情报收集手段外，思想间谍还使用他们的魔法来窥探目标的思想。

entries.name: 葛加理NPC
entries: 在其对死亡的拥抱和对恶臭、腐烂环境的掌控中，葛加理群落吸引了那些在真菌、腐烂和怪物世界中感到舒适的人。

葛加理群落的每个成员都有其功能，像单一更大有机体的部分一样协同工作。与此同时，内部派系争夺权力。最突出的派系是德瓦卡林精灵，其精神领袖伊佐尼并不是行会大师贾拉德的朋友。美杜莎们仍在努力凝聚成一个派系。在死亡祭司马兹雷克的领导下，刻洛尔人正在行会中逐渐获得更多的影响力。这些派系领袖可以作为高尔加里角色的赞助人。他们可能会派遣角色执行任务，以干扰对手或增加自己派系的权力和影响力。他们也可以作为反对葛加理群落的冒险家的主要对手。

Golgari NPCs include reclaimers, who scavenge and recycle corpses and other detritus, and assassins, who belong to a secret society called the Ochran. The Golgari NPCs table summarizes key roles within the guild. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 葛加理NPC
rows: {@creature 卓尔} or {@creature 卓尔精英武者}

entries.name: 伊佐尼，德瓦卡林玛特卡
entries: 德瓦卡林精灵的精神领袖拥有玛特卡的职位。伊佐尼，一位葛加理萨满，在她的前任兹德尼亚可疑死亡后最近升任此职。伊佐尼以其控制昆虫和蜘蛛的能力而闻名，她身边总是伴随着一群或更多的昆虫在她的周围爬行。当她行走时，她看起来像是在地面上滑行。

entries.name: 贾雷·沃德·萨沃
entries: The Golgari guildmaster is a Devkarin necromancer and lich named {@creature 贾雷·沃德·萨沃|GGR}. In life, Jarad was an archer and accomplished hunter, as well as the brother of the previous guildmaster, the ambitious Savra. Jarad mastered the ways of necromancy so he could rise as a lich after he sacrificed himself to save his son from the demon {@creature 拉铎司|GGR}.
作为葛加理虫群的首领，贾拉德指挥着精灵和美杜莎刺客、刻洛尔军团、野蛮的巨魔，以及大量居住在下层城市的生物。得益于他掌握的死灵法术——并且在他忠诚的守卫和士兵的支持下——他成功地躲过了来自各种有抱负者的多次暗杀企图。
不死生物本质。贾拉德不需要空气、食物、饮料或睡眠。
{@b 理想}: "Death. There's wisdom to be gained in it, whether it be your own or someone else's."
{@b 牵挂}: "Ravnica, with all its structures and institutions, will eventually rot away, and it will be time for the Golgari to bloom from the carcass."
{@b 缺点}: "I am beyond life and death and can't be harmed."

entries.name: 葛加理祭司
entries: 葛加理萨满是葛加理群落的精神领袖。他们教授公会对自然循环的信仰，使用他们的死灵魔法展示生命是如何从死亡中萌发的。

Golgari shamans paint their faces so they appear to have extra eyes on their cheeks and chins. They sometimes use magical {@item 貌纹绘彩|GGR} to allow them to communicate by means of these marks. They wear clothing adorned with beetle carapaces, spiderwebs, or shelf fungus.

entries.name: 葛加理巢穴
entries: Members of the Golgari Swarm have an intimate connection to their territory. When at least six Golgari defend their territory together, they can call on the environment to aid them. The group must include {@creature 贾雷·沃德·萨沃|GGR} or at least one Golgari shaman, kraul death priest, undercity medusa, or Devkarin lich. When determining the difficulty of such an encounter, consider the lair to be one additional creature of challenge rating 1.

entries.name: 水晶龙巢穴动作
entries: 在先攻计数20（若先攻平手则失败）时，葛加理群体进行一次巢穴行动，造成以下效果之一；葛加理不能连续两轮使用同一效果：

items: If the Golgari can see any sewer openings, they can cause sewage to overflow. Any creature within 20 feet of such an opening must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition 倒地} and pushed up to 20 feet in a straight line away from the opening.

Spore-laden fungi release a cloud that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the Golgari choose within 120 feet of any member of the group. The cloud spreads around corners and remains until one of the Golgari dismisses it as an action, the Golgari group uses this lair action again, or all the members of the Golgari group die. The area within the cloud is lightly obscured. Any creature in the cloud when it appears must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any creature that ends its turn in the cloud takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage.

Tendrils of creeping fungi reach out to ensnare the enemies of the Golgari. The Golgari choose a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet of any member of the group. Each creature in the area that isn't allied with the Golgari group must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition 束缚} until the Golgari group uses this lair action again, all the members of the group are slain, or no member of the group is within 60 feet of the effect. A creature {@condition 束缚} in this way can use an action to make a {@dc 15} Strength check, ending the {@condition 束缚} effect on itself with a success.

entries.name: 区域效应
entries: 包含葛加理巢穴的区域被苔藓和奇异真菌所侵扰。这种生态环境在周围的地下城市中产生了以下一种或两种效果（这些效果不会扩散到地表）：

items: 苔藓、真菌和其他生长物覆盖了巢穴周围半英里内的所有地下表面。

Fungal spores drifting throughout the lair have the power to animate corpses. Whenever a Small or Medium humanoid dies within the lair, roll a die. On an odd number, the dead creature rises up as a fungus drudge (use the zombie stat block in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM}) {@dice 1d8} hours later, unless its body is destroyed.

entries: If all the Golgari in the lair die, the regional effects fade over {@dice 1d10} days.

entries.name: 古鲁NPC
entries: 像与他们并肩作战的生物一样，古鲁氏族的战士和萨满都非常具有攻击性。
正如其名，古鲁氏族包括许多不同的群体，它们各自拥有自己的领导者和传统。除了六个最突出的氏族（燃烧之树、戈尔、疮疤、斯利兹特、砾石皮、朱尔-塔和博尔拉克）之外，无数的小氏族——有些不过是战争团队——在废墟带中声称领土。
Gruul NPCs fill various clan roles. The Gruul NPCs table summarizes key roles within the guild. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.name: 咕噜力莫
entries: For decades, the enormous cyclops {@creature 咕噜力莫|GGR} has commanded the respect and obedience of the Gruul Clans by defeating all who challenged him. He embodies the raging fire that the Gruul believe burns in their bellies, and his wrath toward the civilization of Ravnica knows no bounds.

Mightiest of the Mighty. {@creature 咕噜力莫|GGR} leads the Burning Tree clan, which is the largest and most diverse of the Gruul Clans. He is almost always accompanied by other members of his clan—not because he needs their protection, but because they might need his. His companions include creatures ranging from burly giants to cowering goblins.
The Gruul follow strength, and {@creature 咕噜力莫|GGR} holds his position only because he has proved stronger than any challenger.
{@b 理想}: "We fight!"
{@b 牵挂}: "I will bring the wilds back."
{@b 缺点}: "I don't have to listen to anybody."

entries.name: 反逆者
entries: 古鲁氏族的普通成员，被称为无政府主义者，他们鄙视文明，并发誓要摧毁其物理结构及其制度。
无政府主义者们搜刮一切，从他们穿戴的兽皮盔甲到他们使用的武器。当他们在废墟带中翻找时，有时会发现魔法物品和其他珍贵宝藏。

entries.name: 古式德鲁伊
entries: 古道德鲁伊是守护古老古鲁传统的人，他们致力于动物神祇的原始凶猛，如伊尔哈格·毁灭野猪和卡沙斯·追踪者。
终结毁灭。古道德鲁伊相信，文明永远不会被零星的袭击和小规模的冲突所根除。他们坚持认为将会有一个即将到来的天启，即终结毁灭，届时伊尔哈格的蹄子将践踏拉尼卡高耸天际线的每块砖石，将其变为废墟。世界将回归自然状态，在这种状态下，无序的力量和野蛮法则将再次统治。

entries.name: 古道德鲁伊尼基亚
entries: The Zhur-Taa leader, Nikya, is a powerful centaur druid of the Old Ways. In fact, she considers herself to be the last of the true Gruul druids. Though raised to be a warrior, Nikya soon discovered her natural gifts with magic. She can summon enormous constricting vines from the ancient layers of Ravnica's crust. She has little love for {@creature 咕噜力莫|GGR}, and she believes that another leader—one who is loyal to the Old Ways—will arise among the Gruul before the End-Raze begins.

entries.name: 瓦砾区伏击客
entries: 废墟带追踪者是古鲁氏族的侦察兵和突击队员。他们擅长在具有挑战性的地形上移动，无论是在危险的废墟中穿行还是在屋顶上攀爬。他们偏爱伏击战术，避免与更强的力量对抗，依靠他们优越的机动性来逃脱。

entries.name: 伊捷公会NPCs
entries: 尽管伊捷联盟的官方职能是维护城市的公共工程，但大多数成员加入这个公会是为了满足他们对魔法知识的无尽好奇心。利用公会的广泛资源和坚固设施，研究人员通过鲁莽的实验来追求他们的研究，这通常以财产破坏、肢体丧失或至少是一声巨响告终。几乎所有伊捷成员都具备一定的魔法能力。

Izzet NPCs include chemisters, who work extensively with the magic alloy mizzium, and their attendants. The Izzet NPCs table summarizes key roles within the guild. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 伊捷公会NPCs
rows: {@creature 变异觅爆师|GGR},* {@creature 宙子觅爆师|GGR},* {@creature 魔力断流觅爆师|GGR},* or {@creature 电击搜寻者|GGR}*

entries.name: 大师化学师格罗兹格罗克斯
entries: Master Chemister Grozgrox is a viashino (lizardfolk) mage with a talent for shaping mizzium. His genius has earned commendations from {@creature 尼米捷|GGR} himself on two separate occasions, a fact that Grozgrox tries to work into conversation as often as possible.

entries.name: 尼米捷
entries: Possessed of arrogance and vanity that matches his vast intellect and tremendous power, {@creature 尼米捷|GGR} is the ancient dragon who founded and continues to control the Izzet League. From his private laboratory at the top of the Izzet guildhall, {@creature 尼米捷|GGR} directs the research and experiments of his countless underlings. He coordinates a tremendous number of apparently unrelated projects, working toward some mysterious end.
毫无疑问，这位古老龙是拉尼卡上最聪明的生物之一，也是世界上最强的施法者之一。他像任何龙一样贪婪，但他的宝藏是科学和魔法知识。他的野心在所有其他公会领袖的心中是一个迫在眉睫的威胁，但由于他惊人的魔法力量和一只喷火、剑齿龙的物理威胁，直接面对他几乎是不可想象的。
{@b 理想}: "Innovation. Don't just have an idea—have all of them."
{@b 牵挂}: "I have spent more than ten thousand years researching the mysteries of the world around me, but there is much more to discover."
{@b 缺点}: "I find it tedious to converse with simpletons who lack vision."

entries.name: 觅爆师
entries: 虽然化学师专注于为公会发明新的工具、武器和其他设备，但爆破者的角色是将这些设备投入使用。尽管名字如此，并非所有这类设备都会产生爆炸，但从伊捷的角度来看，所有最有趣的设备都会。

entries.name: 米兹克斯·伊兹马格努斯
entries: 米兹克斯是一位地精电击爆破者，她以一个低微的助手身份开始了她的伊捷生涯。但她很快就凭借自己的天赋、精明的政治手段和幸运的意外，赢得了自己的魔法锻造场和一队助手。现在，米兹克斯已经上升到伊捷联盟法庭的最高位置，占据了伊兹马格努斯的席位。

entries.name: 欧佐夫NPC
entries: 欧佐夫集团中的每个人，无论是生是死，都在公会的严格等级制度中有一席之地。从构成统治阶层的不死灵奥布泽达特到底层的卑微不死债务人灵，以及中间的活人等级，每个人都清楚自己的位置：谁在他们之上，谁在他们之下，谁欠他们的，以及他们欠谁的。

The Orzhov hierarchy includes advokists who find loopholes in the law to exploit, knights who enforce the guild's will, and indentured spirits. The Orzhov NPCs table summarizes key roles within the guild. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.name: 奥布泽达特，幽灵议会
entries: 组成奥布泽达特的鬼魂传统上被称为族长，尽管他们可以是男性或女性。他们是欧佐夫集团中最古老、最富有、最有影响力的寡头。他们已经死了几个世纪，但他们拒绝放弃生命中积累的财富。沉迷于权力和声望，这些族长继续支配公会并积累更大的财富。
几乎一致。奥布泽达特的鬼魂作为一个单位运作，受到他们共同的欲望驱使，即为公会积累更多的财富。在意见分歧时，议会中最年长的成员运用他的资历来使议会屈服于他的意愿。
族长卡尔洛夫。作为议会的首领，他对议会的决定给予最终批准，并解决团体内部的分歧，被称为族长卡尔洛夫。在生前，卡尔洛夫是欧佐夫寡头中最贪婪的，而他作为灵体的许多世纪并没有减少他对更多财富的渴望。
不死本质。奥布泽达特的鬼魂不需要空气、食物、饮料或睡眠。
{@b 理想}: "Influence is measured in power, status, and money, but mostly money."
{@b 牵挂}: "Gather as much as you can while you can, for when you die, you will take it with you."
{@b 缺点}: "Everyone has a price."

entries.name: 特伊萨·卡尔洛夫
entries: 在奥布泽达特的权威下，特伊萨·卡尔洛夫（一位可以使用欧佐夫公会法术的法师）曾拥有大使的头衔，作为欧佐夫与其他公会领导层互动时的代表。几十年来，欧佐夫的一个显著特点是特伊萨与奥布泽达特之间的紧张关系，特伊萨生活在复杂的政治现实中，而奥布泽达特则是僵化、贪婪的。特伊萨强烈主张奥布泽达特的孤立主义以及他们不愿建立可能使他们依赖其他公会的联盟将导致集团的灭亡。当特伊萨试图在塔吉克——波洛斯教团之刃的帮助下夺取奥布泽达特的权力时，这种紧张关系达到了沸点。她的企图失败了，奥布泽达特监禁了特伊萨，取消了大使之职，取消了与其他公会的所有交易。特伊萨至今仍然在监狱中，幽灵议会通过敲诈腐败官员确保她被关押。

entries.name: 拉铎司公会NPCs
entries: 拉铎司教派吸引着寻求刺激的人。一些成员被享乐的承诺所吸引；其他人则像飞蛾被火舞台的壮观景象所吸引。他们来到一个扭曲的社区，在这里没有冲动是不可接受的，没有行为是太卑鄙的，所有重要的是当下的兴奋和快乐。他们来到这里是为了有机会成为焦点——即使是在火焰中灭亡的恶名，也抱有一丝希望。他们也为了友谊而来，这是一种轻松的伙伴关系，没有瑟雷尼亚的真诚灵性，波洛斯的严格纪律，或欧佐夫的等级制度。

Not every member of the guild is a performer; some members simply tag along to witness the guild's mayhem. The {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} NPCs table summarizes key roles within the guild. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 拉铎司公会NPCs
rows: {@creature 邪教狂信者} or {@creature 邪教徒}
{@creature 拉铎司讽刺派作家|GGR}* or {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} performer ({@creature 拉铎司表演者，刀剑杂耍者|GGR|刀刃杂耍者}, {@creature 拉铎司表演者，火吞者|GGR|吞火者}, or {@creature 拉铎司表演者，高空杂技演员|GGR|高空杂技演员})*

entries.name: 拉铎司
entries: {@creature 拉铎司|GGR}, the demon for whom his cult is named, embodies hedonism. He is also the consummate entertainer, whose mere appearance is an act of grisly performance art. A monstrous figure standing thirty feet tall, spreading enormous wings, crowned with fire and swinging a flaming scythe, {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} demands the spotlight. His every entrance is a showstopper.

Sometimes after his grand entrance, {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} crouches to witness the performances of those who adore him. To them, his opinion is the only one that matters, but he is a demanding spectator. He has seen thousands of years of circus tricks and has no patience for performers who don't give their all. His flaming scythe has brought more than one tepid show to a sudden and spectacular close.

Jaded as he is, {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} attends his cult's performances only rarely. He often retreats into his lair below the cult's guildhall for months or years at a time, but his followers know that he might emerge at any time to witness the latest spectacle.
{@b 理想}: "Everyone should pursue their greatest desire."
{@b 牵挂}: "If you want my favor, show me a performance I've never seen before."
{@b 缺点}: "What is joy?"

entries.name: 血祭司
entries: Blood witches imagine themselves to be the intermediaries between {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} and his cult—the pinnacle of his priesthood, his trusted advisors, and the messengers who communicate his will to the scattered troupes and ringmasters. The Cult of Rakdos recognizes no authority but {@creature 拉铎司|GGR}, and the demon lord requires no advisors. Nonetheless, the blood witches are smart, charismatic, and powerful, so their voices do carry some weight.
血巫师努力保护邪教免受外部干扰，并对那些伤害公会的人进行惩罚。他们声称拥有宏伟的头衔，如沃杰克的折磨者，以此来嘲笑他们的目标受害者。

entries.name: 拉铎司讽刺派作家
entries: One of the most effective weapons in the {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} cult's arsenal is satire, and a {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} lampooner is a virtuoso of that art. Lampooners generally reserve their mockery for people and guilds that have seized an outsized measure of power, those who need to be taken down a peg, rather than piling further humiliation onto those who are already struggling. They use masks, marionettes, or effigies to caricature public figures, or sometimes play pranks on those individuals directly in the streets.

entries.name: 拉铎司表演者
entries: By offering a place for those of many different talents, the Cult of Rakdos has seen its numbers swell with performing artists, including blade jugglers, fire eaters, and high wire acrobats. Performers carry the message of {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} out into the streets: cut loose, free yourself from the bonds of society's mores and expectations, and indulge your desires.

entries.name: 朱迪丝，鞭笞歌姬
entries: Judith appears at {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} clubs and street shows as a singer and performance artist, combining dark soliloquies and bizarre pain stunts. She's the grand dame of the {@creature 拉铎司|GGR}, and what she says backstage goes. Judith covets the adoration heaped on {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} by his cultists. She does countless performances a week, but the big demon gets all the praise. She has begun to assemble a small entourage of fans, toadies, and understudies who echo her complaints about the guild's leader.

entries.name: 拉铎司狂欢节
entries: 当笨重的巨人搭建起临时舞台，咯咯笑的恶魔点燃脚灯时，第一批表演者开始聚集人群。充满活力、节奏不定的音乐从周围社区吸引观众，对表现更出色的表演者的欢呼声——随着表演变得更加危险，第一次流血，观众的喘息声和尖叫声——随之而来。杂技演员在街上嬉戏，而吞剑者和飞刀手挥舞着闪亮的钢刀。人群变得越来越大，越来越狂野，呼喊和尖叫声越来越响，火焰燃烧得更明亮，在火把的照耀下，血液闪烁着红色。这场奇观虽然残酷却扣人心弦；人群不愿观看却无法移开视线。不久，疯狂控制了他们——恶魔和食人魔，杂技演员和观众——被暴力的狂潮所席卷。只有当一切结束后，事件的恐怖才逐渐显现。

A {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} carnival is more than the sum of its performers and its audience. It is a frenzy that grips those present, a fiendish madness that comes on suddenly and departs just as quickly, leaving gore in its wake. The carnival, in fact, has a life of its own—and when adventurers face the Cult of Rakdos in the midst of a revel, the carnival is one more foe arrayed against them.

When at least six {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} performers perform together in public, they can call on the carnival to aid them. When determining the difficulty of such an encounter, consider the carnival to be one additional creature of challenge rating 3.

entries.name: 水晶龙巢穴动作
entries: 在先攻计数20（若先攻平手则失败）时，狂欢节进行一次巢穴行动，造成以下效果之一；狂欢节不能连续两轮使用同一效果：

items: Fire erupts from the ground at up to four points of the DM's choice in the carnival. The fire lasts for 1 minute or until this action is used again. Each jet of flame is a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 5-foot radius. Each creature in the cylinder when it first appears must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any creature that starts its turn in the flames must also make the saving throw.

Whirling blades, spiked chains, or other implements of agony appear for a moment to menace {@dice 1d6} random creatures in a 20-foot cube. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) force damage.
Blood splashes all creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within the carnival. Each creature in that area becomes the target of a {@spell 困惑术} spell (save {@dc 15}).

entries.name: 区域效应
entries: 狂欢节对那些接近庆典的人施加了强大的影响：

items: When a creature that is outside the carnival sees or hears it, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use its movement each round to move toward the carnival. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.

If a creature attempts to leave the carnival, the creature must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature instead moves toward the center of the carnival. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.

entries: If all the {@creature 拉铎司|GGR} performers in the carnival die or leave its area, these effects end immediately.

entries.name: 瑟雷尼亚NPC
entries: 那些被瑟雷尼亚盟会吸引的人发现公会的包容和和谐使命很吸引人。他们从公会与文明和未被驯服的自然和平共处中获得安慰和满足。但公会的驱动力不仅仅是将人们吸引到一个和平的社区：瑟雷尼亚的目标是建立一支军队。他们并不天真；他们意识到其他公会的野心将导致暴力，他们计划为此做好准备。

Despite the guild's atmosphere of peaceful quietude, many of its members have military roles. The Selesnya NPCs table summarizes key roles within the guild. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 瑟雷尼亚NPC
rows: {@creature 斥候} mounted on a {@creature 飞马}
{@creature 骑士} mounted on a {@creature 恐狼}

entries.name: 卓塔妮
entries: The Selesnya guildmaster is an amalgamation of three dryads in body, will, and soul. Each dryad's body extends from a central trunk, so while they possess independent minds, they share a single name—{@creature 卓塔妮|GGR}—and a single life force. Usually {@creature 卓塔妮|GGR} communicates the will of the Worldsoul with one voice, but she retains three distinct personalities that embody the three parts of the Selesnyan ideal: order, life, and harmony. In the midst of increasing tensions on Ravnica, the three personalities have recently been at odds over how best to navigate the conclave through such difficult times.

{@creature 卓塔妮|GGR} spends most of her time in the towering tree of Vitu-Ghazi, the Selesnya guildhall. There she communes with Mat'Selesnya and with the dryads who lead individual Selesnya communities across Ravnica.
{@b 理想}: "In each of us is the strength of all of us."
{@b 牵挂}: "All will come to the warm embrace of the Conclave."
{@b 缺点}: "I have nothing but anger for those who break the bonds of the community and leave our embrace."

entries.name: 唤角师
entries: 被称为号角使者的专业萨满使用他们的魔法召唤野生猛兽，与瑟雷尼亚部队并肩作战。在和平时期，他们照料与瑟雷尼亚飞地和公园相关的动物。

entries.name: 艾玛拉·坦德里斯
entries: An elf priest, Emmara Tandris is committed to pursuing peace between the guilds with all her heart, even as {@creature 卓塔妮|GGR} hesitates in self-conflict. As a friend of Jace Beleren, she understands that he's never going to be able to settle on Ravnica, so she believes the world needs a replacement for the Guildpact. Emmara plays an active role in her community, and she has many non-Selesnya friends aside from the Guildpact. One of the most active advocates of cooperation among the guilds, she is relying on personal connections with members of other guilds to help that effort.

entries.name: 析米克公会NPCs
entries: 对生命种种奇迹的好奇心——以及涉及修改它的魔法科学——吸引着来自拉尼卡各地的好奇和有抱负的头脑加入析米克联合体。析米克科学家们以族群和项目为单位聚集在一起，寻找加速自然适应和进化过程的新方法，准备各种有机体以在危险且不断变化的城市环境中茁壮成长。

Most Simic researchers are humans, vedalken, elves, and merfolk, or at least they were born that way. During their careers, they might give themselves such a wide variety of adaptations and augmentations that their heritage is hard to ascertain. The Simic NPCs table summarizes key roles within the guild. Statistics for these NPCs are found in the {@book 怪物图鉴|MM} unless the table states otherwise.

entries.caption: 析米克公会NPCs
rows: 生物巫师（创造混血生物）
力场法师（培养植物和动物）
{@creature 德鲁伊} or {@creature 魔法师}

entries.name: 首席演说家泽加纳
entries: The regal and reticent Prime Speaker {@creature 泽加娜|GGR} is the merfolk guildmaster of the Simic Combine. She upholds the traditional ways of the guild and its utopian philosophy, which espouses a vision of an ideal world in which nature and civilization coexist in perfect balance. Some people in the guild—members of the Adaptationist faction in particular—argue that her ways are outdated and the guild requires more practical leadership. In response, {@creature 泽加娜|GGR} maintains that she serves as prime speaker only at the sufferance of the Speakers' Chamber, and if the other speakers wish to replace her, they are certainly within their rights to do so.
{@b 理想}: "Nature's patterns are the schematics for how to improve."
{@b 牵挂}: "I will use all the resources at my disposal to see that Ravnica becomes the best it can be."
{@b 缺点}: "I can't understand how progress could ever be the wrong goal."

entries.name: 生机术士
entries: 析米克生物工程中的几乎所有创新和进步都来自生物巫师的工作。作为通过科学和魔法混合杂交和改变生物的专家，他们创造了无数的混血生物和克拉斯，以寻找自然与文明之间完美融合的方式。
